item.title: Jay-Z picks himself to headline the Super Bowl halftime show in Southern California
item.description: The NFL, Apple Music and Roc Nation announced Monday night that Jay-Z will be the featured performer for the halftime festivities on Feb. 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California.

item.title: These 'Seven Stories About Tammy' add up to one brilliant piece of writing
item.description: Elizabeth McCracken's connected short stories chronicle a family's encounters with their eldest son's girlfriend and eventual wife. This slim collection is so engaging, you may want to read it twice.
item.content:encoded: Elizabeth McCracken's connected short stories chronicle a family's encounters with their eldest son's girlfriend and eventual wife. This slim collection is so engaging, you may want to read it twice.

item.title: 'New Yorker' cartoonists confess to the horrors lurking in their kitchens
item.description: Roz Chast and Jason Adam Katzenstein discuss roaches, molding food and dysfunctional appliances. Their new graphic memoir, The Two Saddest Kitchens, reveals it all.

item.title: In this new kids' book, it's 'Snow Geese Season' for a little boy and his Pop
item.description: Every fall, snow geese migrating south stop in Vermont and cover the ground in a snowy white blanket. Now, a new picture book celebrates that real-life awe-inspiring event.

item.title: When a teen posts a selfie, how much filter is 'too much' filter?
item.description: The recent Meta settlement includes a clause banning "cosmetic procedure filters" for teens. But defining what constitutes an extreme makeover isn't easy.
